traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 species aggregate for Fouquieria splendens (gwddagg_v2.2_species.csv, read): specific gravity 0.49 (wsg_est, the database's hierarchical-model species mean, from 1 record in 1 source); trunks 0.49, branches 0.49. Basic density (oven-dry mass over green volume) is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a clump of 6 to 50 unbranched, spiny, grey canes 2 to 6 m long rising from a short crown like an upturned vase; small leaves sprout along the canes within days of rain and fall when it dries; scarlet tubular flowers in a panicle at each cane's tip in spring. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough heights from general knowledge of the species: about 3 m at 12 years and 5 m at 40. Wide tolerances.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye from photographs: grey canes, bright green leaves after rain, scarlet flowers. Its flower laid out whorl by whorl (spec rework P5b): a scarlet tube of five joined petals, five sepals, thirteen stamens and a superior pistil of three carpels, from the characters of Fouquieriaceae by the rules at the flowering plants.
